_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Fresh continuous white silicone caulk bead at a white bathtub and subway-tile joint
figures.caption: Inspect the tub or shower joint, corners, trim, and movement before removing old caulk. Recaulking will not fix a leaking substrate or a loose surround.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Clear shower-door side seal meeting an even tiled jamb gap
figures.caption: Remove loose bead and residue, dry the joint, and tool one continuous bead without leaving pinholes at corners or changes in plane. Protect nearby seals while the work is done.

figures.alt: Clean bathroom tile floor with a controlled grout-joint preparation area
figures.caption: Respect the product cure time before running water. Jacksonville humidity can slow the set, and an early shower test can make a sound new bead look like a failed seal.
